CustomObject.description: One record per Profile Name. Drives which of the 5 dashboard link tiles the Home Snapshot component shows for the running user - a custom, admin-maintainable substitute for real Salesforce Dashboard-folder sharing, since all 4 standard Dashboards currently live in one shared folder and can't express per-dashboard-per-profile visibility that way. Looked up by Profile.Name (case-sensitive exact match) at runtime, not by Profile Id, so this survives a profile being recreated/cloned as long as the name is kept.
CustomObject.label: Dashboard Tile Access
